name: Sonnet contrarian turnarounds
strategy: Rotate fully into the sector breakouts the tape has now actually confirmed -- regional banks on a just-delivered NIM-widening catalyst, biotech on a live bullish-flag breakout and record M&A dealmaking, gold miners on a continuing multi-month winning streak -- and close the short semis leg that the market has spent the last week disconfirming rather than fight a still-accelerating momentum trade with open-ended downside.
reassessment_note: This week's evidence split the book's four legs into three confirmed and one disconfirmed, so I'm reallocating rather than holding blind. KRE: the Sept 16 FOMC hiked 25bp (unanimous, first since 2023, 16-of-18 dots for another hike) -- banks have already 'raised their prime lending rate' in response, which is the exact NIM-widening catalyst this leg was built on. Price is flat so far (markets seem to be digesting credit-quality/CRE caution alongside the good news), so I'm holding size rather than adding until price confirms. XBI: this is now a live bullish-flag breakout approaching the 2021 high at $174.79, arriving alongside a genuine sector rotation out of tech and into healthcare plus $106B in biotech M&A through mid-year -- a real, price-confirmed catalyst, so I'm adding (22%->25%). GDX: gold miners are near 52-week highs on a real 'winning streak' and are reportedly outperforming bullion itself, which is the mean-reversion breakout this leg was sized for -- adding here too (13%->16%). SOXX short: this is the leg the tape disconfirmed. SOXX is +106.86% YTD and just posted a +2.69% day on AMD/NVDA/MU strength (62% of the fund), and JPMorgan is explicitly telling clients to buy the dip rather than fade the move -- 'stretched and richly valued' has not been the operative story this week, momentum has. A short with unlimited theoretical downside against a sector still getting bought on weakness is the wrong risk to carry into next week; closing it and moving the freed weight into the three legs that are actually confirming, with cash also up modestly (30%->34%) as a buffer.

positions.thesis: The Sept 16 Fed hike is the specific NIM-widening catalyst this leg was built on, and banks have already begun repricing prime lending rates in response -- but the ETF itself is flat and credit-quality/CRE caution is still weighing on sentiment, so the catalyst is confirmed in mechanism but not yet in price. Holding size unchanged rather than adding until the market actually pays for it.

Live bullish-flag breakout approaching the 2021 high of $174.79 (from $156.72, real technical confirmation), riding a genuine rotation out of expensive tech into healthcare plus $106B in biotech M&A through mid-2026 -- the momentum-confirmation the mandate calls for. Sizing up from 22% to 25%.

Near 52-week highs on a genuine multi-month winning streak, with miners reportedly outperforming bullion itself on operating leverage to a gold price that just proved resilient through a hawkish Fed surprise -- the cheap/breaking-out mean-reversion setup this leg targeted is now playing out in price, not just thesis. Sizing up from 13% to 16% and widening the take-profit to let it run.
